summary: Completed Module 01 BREAK analysis. Pinpointed the direct contradiction between provider cancellation autonomy in original Paragraph 2 and the universal 24-hour platform refund mandate in updated Paragraph 1. Uncovered the dangerous temporal flaw: measuring 'within 24 hours of booking' (creation time) rather than lead time before appointment start, which penalizes advance bookings while enabling last-minute exploitations documented in progress/decomposition/module-01/break-diagnosis.md.
evidence: Identified direct architectural contradiction: Provider-specific policy vs. universal platform rule.
Exposed temporal reference flaw: 'within 24 hours of booking' vs. 'hours prior to appointment'.
Analyzed two concrete failure scenarios: 30-day advance booking penalty vs. 10-minute last-minute booking exploitation.
